## Detailed Services Catalog

### 1. Wedding Band & Baraat Brass Band
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/wedding-band
- **Hindi Name**: शादी के लिए बैंड बाजा — बारात बैंड, दिल्ली
- **Description**: Uniformed live brass band leading baraats across Delhi NCR since 1996. Features trumpets, clarinets, side drums, and large bass drums playing Bollywood hits, Punjabi dance anthems, and classical ceremonial tunes.
- **Band Sizes**: Flexible group sizes ranging from compact procession groups up to 21, 31, and 51-piece royal brass band formations.
- **Uniforms**: Traditional matching ceremonial attire complete with royal safas / turbans.
- **Key FAQs**:
  - *Can we select our playlist?* Yes. Families can provide a custom list of Bollywood, Punjabi, and traditional songs in advance.
  - *Until what time can the band perform in Delhi?* In accordance with Delhi Police and the Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules 2000, loudspeakers and outdoor amplified music must conclude by 10:00 PM.

### 2. Royal Groom Ghodi (White Wedding Mare)
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/ghodi-for-wedding
- **Hindi Name**: शादी के लिए सजी हुई घोड़ी — घुड़चढ़ी, दिल्ली
- **Description**: Healthy, calm, well-trained snow-white wedding mares adorned with traditional silver and gold ceremonial zardozi saddles, embellished reins, and headgear.
- **Inclusions**: Dedicated experienced horse handler walking alongside throughout the procession, matching safa, and ceremonial umbrella on request. Trained specifically to remain calm amidst firecrackers, brass music, and dancing crowds.

### 3. Luxury Flower Baggi & Rath Chariot
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/flower-baggi-rath
- **Hindi Name**: फूलों वाली बग्गी और बारात का रथ — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Victorian-style horse-drawn carriages and royal Bahubali-style open chariots decorated with fresh orchids, carnations, roses, and warm ambient LED lighting. Available in 2-horse and 4-horse arrangements.
- **Usage**: Groom grand entry, royal bride entry, or couple vidaai procession.

### 4. Authentic Punjabi Dhol Players
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/dhol-wale
- **Hindi Name**: शादी और बारात के लिए पंजाबी ढोल वाले — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Seasoned Punjabi dhol masters in vibrant, matching traditional kurtas, chadras, and phulkari safas.
- **Usage**: High-energy bhangra beats for the dancing stretches of the baraat, groom entry at the venue gate, and sangeet / mehendi ceremonies.

### 5. Chhatri Lights, Jhumar & Road Lighting
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/wedding-lights
- **Hindi Name**: छतरी लाइट, झाड़ फानूस और बारात की रोशनी — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Handcrafted crystal chhatri lanterns carried alongside both flanks of the baraat, royal vintage jhumars (chandeliers), and road lighting units.
- **Power Source**: Accompanied by sound-dampened mobile generator setups that provide stable power without drowning out the music.

### 6. Complete Baraat Package
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/baraat-package
- **Hindi Name**: शादी बारात का पूरा पैकेज — बैंड, घोड़ी, बग्गी, ढोल और लाइट
- **Description**: The comprehensive all-inclusive wedding package combining royal brass band, decorated ghodi, fresh flower baggi, dhol players, and crystal chhatri lighting under single-point coordination directly with owner Manish Kumar. Eliminates multi-vendor coordination hassles on the wedding night.

### 7. Bagpiper Band
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/bagpiper-band
- **Hindi Name**: शादी के लिए बैगपाइपर बैंड — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Traditional Scottish-style military bagpipe and drum ensemble in authentic tartan uniforms and feather bonnets, ideal for dignified royal wedding entries.

### 8. Shehnai Players
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/shehnai-wedding
- **Hindi Name**: शादी के लिए शहनाई वादक — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Classical shehnai masters accompanied by traditional nagada and tabla percussion, performing raag-based auspicious melodies during wedding ceremonies, jaimala, and religious welcoming rituals.

### 9. Vintage Wedding Car Rental
- **URL**: https://shivband.in/services/vintage-car-wedding
- **Hindi Name**: शादी और बारात के लिए विंटेज कार किराए पर — दिल्ली
- **Description**: Chauffeur-driven classic vintage cars decorated with tasteful floral accents for distinctive groom entry and timeless photographic backdrops.

## Pricing Policy & Zero-Surge Guarantee
- **Fair Family Rates**: Shiv Band charges transparent, fair family rates based strictly on chosen troop size (11 to 31+ musicians), vehicle selection (ghodi, 2-horse/4-horse baggi, rath, vintage car), and travel distance.
- **Zero-Surge Guarantee**: Rates never surge, inflate, or fluctuate based on peak wedding season or auspicious (Saya) dates. Function dates are checked strictly for slot availability and artist scheduling, never to alter pricing.
- **Direct Proprietor Booking**: Direct booking with owner Manish Kumar ensures zero middleman commissions, transparent quotations, and guaranteed artist accountability.
- **Interactive Budget Planner**: https://shivband.in/packages
- **Cost Guide & Budgeting Advice**: https://shivband.in/guides/wedding-band-cost-delhi

## Direct Booking & Contact Policy
- Bookings are handled directly by proprietor Manish Kumar. No third-party agents, aggregators, or brokers are involved.
- Booking confirmation requires agreeing on the event date, timing, starting point, route length, and combination of services.
- Advance reservation is recommended to secure preferred date slots, but rates remain completely consistent regardless of booking lead time or wedding season dates.
